about: WireGuard's precomputed initial handshake state, as one independent implementation publishes it: Ci = Hash(Construction) and Hi = Hash(Ci || Identifier), whitepaper section 5.4.2's first two lines. This is NOT a handshake vector and NOT from an authoritative implementation (wireguard-go and the Linux module compute these at start-up instead of publishing them). It pins one WireGuard-specific step the Noise vector cannot: that the Identifier is the Noise prologue. Consumed by web/src/lib/netkeys/wireguard.ts; see references/net-key-schedules.md.
